small_guidance: The conv_transpose3d_kernel dominates at 96.5% (8ms) and is register-limited (100 regs/thread, 16.7% occupancy). Reduce register pressure by shrinking BLOCK_SPATIAL/BLOCK_OC tiles and/or splitting the inner KD/KH/KW static_range loops; add configs with BLOCK_OC=8/BLOCK_SPATIAL=32 to raise occupancy. Also fuse BatchNorm folding (scale/shift from running stats) and the mean-subtract directly into the conv epilogue to eliminate the separate cudnn BN and fused_bn kernels.
large_guidance: Redesign as a gather-style im2col GEMM keyed on output tiles: one program per (N, OC_tile, output-spatial-tile) computing a proper tl.dot over the IC*KD*KH*KW reduction axis with BLOCK_K=16/32, instead of the current scalar outer-product accumulation that produces 100 reg/thread and only 33% memory throughput. Use channels-last layout for the output and fold BN (folded as affine using running_mean/var at eval, or compute mean/var on the fly) plus the spatial-mean subtraction into the kernel epilogue so conv_out is never materialized for BN. Switch BatchNorm to manual constant-folding (avoid cudnn BN call) since training=True still uses running stats only after BN updates—use F.batch_norm with track_running_stats appropriately or fold weights manually.
